description: Source code for a Python class 'Launcher' implementing RDK-specific logic for launching and managing tests on a Raspberry Pi 4 platform, including process control, SSH interactions, and test execution management.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching and managing tests on RDK platforms, handling SSH connections, process control, and test execution.

methods.name: _InitPexpectCommands
methods.description: Initializes commands for SSH and rsync operations, and sets up test tags and payloads.

methods.name: _CommandBackoff
methods.description: Implements a delay between commands to prevent overwhelming the target.

methods.name: _ShutdownBackoff
methods.description: Performs backoff during shutdown, checking if shutdown has been initiated.

methods.name: _PexpectSpawnAndConnect
methods.description: Spawns a pexpect process to connect via SSH and handles login prompts.

methods.name: _PexpectSendLine
methods.description: Sends a command line to the pexpect process.

methods.name: _PexpectReadLines
methods.description: Reads output lines from the pexpect process, detecting test completion tags.

methods.name: _Sleep
methods.description: Sends a sleep command to the remote shell and waits for completion.

methods.name: _CleanupPexpectProcess
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the pexpect process.

methods.name: _WaitForPrompt
methods.description: Waits until the shell prompt appears, indicating readiness.

methods.name: _KillExistingCobaltProcesses
methods.description: Kills leftover Cobalt processes on the target to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test launch sequence, including file transfer, SSH connection, and test execution.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Stops the launcher and aborts ongoing processes.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Returns the path where test outputs can be written.
